qs.ours: The effects of a moral address are compared, by Seneca (Epistle xxxviii.) to the growth of seed: " Seminis modo, quod, quamvis sit exiguum, cum occupavit idoneum locum, vires suas explicat, et ex minimo in maximos auctus diffundatur. Idem facit oratio.'^
